steps.content: The thick darkness drowns everything in an instant. Just like that, the world falls silent.
In this boundless space, only vague shapes are flashing before your eyes, strange and ceaseless.
But this place feels familiar. You recognize this is Enfer's power. The False One is Enfer's work. And what you're seeing now is...
Enfer's own fear.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Chief, look. I can't believe... I used to be scared of these things...
Suddenly hearing Enfer's voice in the dark, you look ahead. Not far from you, with her hands on her back, Enfer is staring at a glowing object resembling a screen in a cinema.
Images of Enfer you've never seen are being played on a loop on it.

steps.speaker: Little Girl
steps.content: Wah...! Mommy! The bee stung me!

steps.speaker: Little Enfer
steps.content: It hurts... I'm afraid of bees... Sob... I want a world without bees!
The little child sticks up her injured finger and runs into a woman's embrace with teary eyes.

steps.speaker: Young Enfer
steps.content: Ptui!

steps.speaker: Young Enfer
steps.content: It's so hot... It must have burned off my skin...

steps.speaker: Young Enfer
steps.content: Ouch...
Watching the girl on the screen push the cup filled with hot black tea away, Enfer can't help laughing.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Haha... For a child...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Fear is nothing more than a sting of a bee or hot tea burning your palate.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: The things they created are... extremely childish, lively, and naive.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But also so fragile that they shatter upon a mere touch... just like their creators.
Enfer walks forward, even beckoning to you after a few steps.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: There should be even more visual engravings in the depths of my memories. Come see them with me.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Wasn't it screaming that... it knew my weakness, knew why I was lost...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Then let me go and find out what exactly is hidden in the deepest part of my fear and making me lost.
You follow her and advance slowly tracing the path left by Enfer.
Until another screen pops up before you.
The screen is no longer bright. It's very dim, as if covered by heavy dark clouds.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I recognize these clouds.
Staring at the screen, Enfer murmurs.
As if proving her words, thunder explodes on the screen, blinding you, but still unable to light up this fear.

steps.speaker: Young Enfer
steps.content: Dad...?

steps.speaker: Young Enfer
steps.content: Have you seen... Mom?

steps.speaker: Enfer's Father
steps.content: Mom? Isn't she right here?
Lightning flashes and thunder rolls. The sight before the girl's eyes is illuminated...
The warmth under her feet is not the hot water she imagined, and the smell lingering in her nose is not that of soil on a rainy day.

steps.speaker: Enfer's Father
steps.content: Remember it! Learn it well!!
The young girl is dragged close to her father's face and then dropped to the floor. Her father grabs her face, forbidding her to turn away.

steps.speaker: Enfer's Father
steps.content: Only in this way... Only in this way can I succeed! They say that the most exhilarating inspiration lies in the space between life and death! Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Enfer's Father
steps.content: You will have... an extremely successful father! And family!
All of the girl's senses are amplified, except for her hearing. She can't hear any sound, not even her own heartbeat.
She stares at the still trembling corner of fabric before her, her entire mind blank.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Go...
Enfer clenches her hands, shivering slightly.
A scream rips through the silence. You turn to its source at once...
In the screen, the girl is shoved away, her body tumbling to the side.
Her eyes widen fearfully, watching her father's chisel falling again and again.
Is this...?!
The scene on the screen begins rewinding, going back to when the girl is shoved away. It keeps replaying the same scene endlessly.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Why... Why would I see her here... This... shouldn't be.
Light and shade intertwine on Enfer's face. You can't make out her expression but only hear her mumbling.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Mother... Mother...
Enfer calls out softly, her voice flowing toward you.
Everything is still being replayed on a loop on the screen, like a curse deepening in the heart with each hit of the chisel.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: ...What?
The person shoving Enfer away. That figure. You've been looking at her for a while and realize she looks exactly like the person taking the final blow for Enfer in the Witching Hour.
I know why she's here... Enfer.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: No... She shouldn't... From that day on, she's been taken away from my world...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: There's only ever been fear in my mind ever since!
You leave that mark unconsciously because... she's branded love in the depths of your consciousness.
That's why you've always feared love, Enfer.
This... is your source of love.
Enfer lifts her head slowly and stares at you with wide eyes, as shocked as the girl on the screen.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Source of... love?

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Hah... Yes, yes! This is the love left in you all along! The love you haven't abandoned all this time!
The surrounding darkness is stirring, and the terrifying voice speaks again, enveloping both of you in the center.

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Because of her, because of this so-called love! You are lost and treading water!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I am... Because of her... Her redemption... Her love...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: That's why I'm weak...

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Yes!!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: You've witnessed it. You must be able to inherit it!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Pure fear, and terror of mankind! Only with them can you create the most perfect piece!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: You need no love. All you need is fear... fright... wails!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Get rid of her! Chop her up! Give up! Forget! Abandon!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: You know what to do.
The darkness under your feet begins stirring. Once again, it transforms into a melted liquid, pouring in like asphalt.
Enfer! Don't listen to it!!
As soon as you notice something's wrong, you begin sprinting toward Enfer. But no matter how fast you run, the distance between you doesn't seem to be shortening at all.
These memories are planted deep in your consciousness! The love you've been given is hidden in the depths of your consciousness!
Do you really want to erase them?!
This thing... This so-called erasure! It's no solution to your perplexity and weakness at all! You're only running away! You have to face it!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Shut up... Shut up, shut up, shut up!!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: You... There's no fear in you, no truth in you! You don't deserve to, should not, and cannot exist here!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: Get away from her! Get away from me! Get away from her! Get away from me!
Your words seem to have crossed The False One. It's screaming, stirring up the tsunami-like black silt to charge at you!
It turns into one spike after another, clinking and clanking as they rip this space apart like countless black chisels.
You... You are the one who should leave!
Enfer! This is your mind! Your consciousness!
All of your power comes from here, doesn't it?!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But my power... is restrained by my weakness...
Don't listen to its nonsense!
Pure fear can grant you immense power to go forward, but it can't get you out of the abyss. It'll only turn you into part of it.
A moth doesn't break the cocoon to purify herself. The intricate patterns and colors are her stunning features too.
You said she would burn in the flame... But who can say for sure that the moth only has fear in her heart when she plunges into the flame?
Enfer shudders and turns around to look at you silently, her eyes filled with an inquisitive light.
Maybe, she loves the flame, and that's why she plunges into it unwaveringly despite her fear?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: She... loves the flame?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: There isn't only fear in her power. There's love too, right?
Yes.

options: Don't run away from love, Enfer.

choices.text: Don't run away from love, Enfer.

steps.content: The False One is angered again. Its throat is rumbling, like thunder brewing in the dark clouds.
Controlling those black spikes, it engulfs Enfer completely while turning the spikes into black needles, raining upon you!
Tsk... Guess I missed the good timing...
Then I guess I can only... bet everything on this.
You turn around and look at Enfer who's been completely devoured not far away. The red shackles on your hand grow and spread out like thorns.
The black rain pours down...
Stop. You don't deserve to touch him.
steps.female_content: Stop. You don't deserve to touch her.

steps.content: The black needles halt a few centimeters from you, unable to move.
You glance at the shackles, but they're still an inch away from reaching your Sinner.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: That's right. This place is my mark, my consciousness...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Everything here should serve me.
The colors in the darkness are stirring anxiously, as if chased by immense fear and eager to escape from this place.
You see the black liquid enveloping Enfer begin struggling. Each movement obviously takes a toll on it, but it refuses to stop... until a small hole gradually opens up in its chest.
Soon, a pair of lithe hands reach out from the hole, grip the terrifying black substance, and rip it apart vehemently...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You thought you could trap me... with just this?
The blue figure emerges from the thick black cocoon. She lifts her head proudly and gazes at the shadows filling her consciousness.
Her gaze reminds you of the person who broke open the Gate of Hell before you in the Witching Hour.
Lofty and arrogant.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Erase... or bury my own perplexity and weakness?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Ha, then I'll only become like you, become a sculpture that will eventually be forgotten a century later, slumbering in a dark basement eternally!

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: And finally... turn into ashes and vanish.
Enfer raises her hands and grips her weapons, the blue hammer and chisel.
She makes her way to you step by step, showered in the black needles with you.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I... named you False because everything about you was your own illusion. You were trapped by your own falsehoods.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: The one who can't see the truth... Is you.

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: It can't be! It can't be! She's made you weak. She's kept you in hell!

steps.speaker: The False One
steps.content: You've always thought that! I know it!
Enfer raises her chisel and aims it at a point in the air, smiling.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Yes, she gives me no choice but to walk in hell... But isn't that my favorite place? ...Hell?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I... am your witness, but definitely not your successor.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You fear love, fear the hell that love will eventually bring you... so you don't want to face it.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But I am different.
Holding up the blue hammer, Enfer slams it hard on the chisel, making a loud clank when it hits that spot in the air.
The black color peels off bit by bit to reveal a heart-shaped mark, the mark present on every one of Enfer's works.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: It's all thanks to love... that I can survive in this living hell.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: And even in a world like this, someone has told me that... just like terror, love can become my power too.
Enfer comes next to you and helps you up. She lets you hold the chisel with her to aim at that heart-shaped mark.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I'm the ruler of fear, so I will not fear love... I will carve through it... Make love a part of my power, so I can keep on creating, tearing, and reincarnating...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Until the most perfect artwork is created.
Enfer looks at you as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Cast the shackles, Chief.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I will break the cocoon with you.
Red and blue light outshines everything in the consciousness, devouring darkness and chasing it away completely.
Under the light, you see a vibrantly blue moth struggle free from a black cocoon, spreading its wings in the air.
Wings flashing a fiery light, it flutters and flies off to somewhere far away.
Hell may be its destination, but this time... you're certain she isn't only accompanied by fear.
